text: In the year nine six three, an entire Chapter of Space Marines vanished.
The Fire Hawks boarded their great fortress-ship, the Raptorus Rex, and entered the warp.
No wreck was found. No message. Not a single survivor.
Then, on battlefields across the galaxy, a new legend began.
When all hope is lost, warriors in black armour appear, wreathed in ghostly fire.
The Legion of the Damned. They save the doomed, then vanish without a word.
Some say they are the lost Fire Hawks, burning forever in the warp.
No one knows for sure. And the Legion never speaks.
